title: Channels carry participants instead of an owner
description:
**Phase 5 of 7.**

- **Blocked by:** 14f692
- **Runs in parallel with:** 6c1a9b and ddf609 in logic, but NOT in merge order. See the warning
- **Unblocks:** 24df70

---
**Scheduling warning.** This, 6c1a9b, and ddf609 all edit models.py and messaging/store.py. They are independent in logic and will collide in the same files. Give all three to one agent, or merge them strictly one at a time and rebase between.

Channel drops user_id. ChannelParticipant{kind, actor_id} already models multi-actor membership, so the real change is the roster index at messaging/store.py:565, which keys a channel by channel.user_id and becomes one roster item per human participant so that listing a person's channels stays a query rather than a scan.
